wrong.why: The Greek names Judas of James (Ἰούδαν Ἰακώβου), a patronymic, and does not state a brotherhood between James and Thaddaeus.

missing.why: Ἰούδαν Ἰακώβου identifies Judas by his father James, using the same patronymic construction as James of Alphaeus in verse 15.

note: The KJV supplies 'the brother of' where the Greek has only the patronymic genitive; this chapter does not explicitly identify Judas of James with Thaddaeus.
